questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Three people A, B and C each either always tell the truth or always lie. A says, 'B is truthful.' B says, 'C is truthful.' C says, 'A and B are different types.' If A is a liar, what must be true?
options: B is truthful and C is truthful
B is truthful and C is a liar
B is a liar and C is truthful
B and C are both liars
questions.solution: A lying means B is not truthful, so B is a liar. B then lies when saying C is truthful, so C is a liar? Wait, if B lies, C is not truthful, hence C is a liar. Therefore D, not B.
